requirement: Confirm that the official NCT05293951 uploads are the governing prospective protocol and separate Statistical Analysis Plan created 4 February 2022; retain the reference plan as annotation-only and do not claim that either PDF itself prints the assigned NCT.
acceptable_values: PDFs say NCT not yet assigned

evidence.text: The protocol gives the full study title, creation date February 4th 2022 and NCT number not yet assigned.
The separate plan repeats the exact title, date and pre-assignment NCT placeholder.

notes: Association depends on the official registry file binding rather than an NCT printed inside the PDFs.

requirement: Describe an assessor-blinded randomized two-arm parallel pilot feasibility trial in post-stroke upper-limb rehabilitation comparing resisted mirror-aided cross-education with mirror therapy using the same device without resistance.

evidence.text: The design and arm descriptions define the assessor-blinded randomized pilot and resisted versus unresisted Mirror Strengthening Device comparison.

requirement: Specify allocation ratio, block sizes or variable-block policy, allocation concealment and how gender and baseline function enter the randomization rule; retain assignment after baseline by a statistician otherwise uninvolved in the trial.

evidence.text: The protocol says assignment follows baseline using computer-generated block random numbers considering gender and function, prepared by a statistician not otherwise involved, but omits operational details.

requirement: Resolve masking before finalization: the protocol supports independent outcome-assessor blinding only, while registry metadata labels participants and outcome assessors masked; state who was intended to be masked and how the visibly resisted versus unresisted exercise contrast preserves masking.

evidence.text: The protocol explicitly calls the design assessor blinded and assigns visibly different resistance conditions, without claiming participant masking.

notes: The frozen registry snapshot names participant and outcomes-assessor masking, creating a source conflict.

requirement: Preserve the common home program of five days per week for four weeks, with five-minute warm-up and cool-down and up to four sets of five repetitions of five shoulder exercises; the experimental arm uses set resistance and the control uses no resistance.

evidence.text: The intervention section gives the warm-up, cool-down, sets, repetitions, exercises, frequency, duration and arm-specific resistance.

requirement: Operationalize intervention exposure and adherence from the before-and-after session diary, including scheduled-session denominator, completed sessions, repetitions, achieved resistance or progression, breaks, deviations and arm-specific compliance summaries.

evidence.text: The protocol prescribes sessions, permits fatigue breaks and requires a training diary before and after every session but gives no adherence derivation.

requirement: Analyze scheduled outcome assessments at baseline before the home program, immediately after the four-week program and at three-month follow-up.

evidence.text: Outcome measures are scheduled before and after the four-week home program and at three months.

requirement: Reconcile the primary-outcome hierarchy: the protocol labels both isokinetic strength and grip strength primary, whereas registry metadata lists only isokinetic upper-limb strength as primary; name the governing primary or co-primary endpoints and primary time point.

evidence.text: Under Primary, the protocol lists isokinetic strength measured by Biodex and grip strength measured by hand-held dynamometer.

notes: The frozen registry snapshot lists isokinetic upper-limb strength alone as primary.

requirement: Define the isokinetic and grip-strength endpoints, including tested side and movement, device settings, units, replicate and quality-control rules, selected summary, direction of benefit and baseline-to-follow-up quantity.

evidence.text: The protocol names Biodex isokinetic strength and hand-held dynamometer grip strength but gives no statistical derivations.

requirement: Treat Fugl-Meyer Upper Extremity, Stroke Impact Scale and Modified Ashworth Scale as distinct secondary outcomes, define score versions and directions, and resolve whether upper-limb range of motion from registry metadata belongs in the prospective secondary family.

evidence.text: The protocol lists three separate secondary instruments and does not list range of motion.

notes: The frozen registry snapshot additionally lists goniometric range of motion as secondary.

requirement: Define the pilot feasibility outcomes, denominators, summaries and any progression thresholds for recruitment, retention, assessment completion, intervention delivery, adherence, diary completion and device use; do not infer feasibility from clinical significance tests alone.

evidence.text: Feasibility is a stated objective and diaries are collected, but no operational outcomes or thresholds are defined.

requirement: Define the safety population, training risk window, adverse-effect categories, severity, relatedness, action taken, withdrawals and arm-level participant and event incidence summaries using diary and researcher-contact reports.

evidence.text: Adverse effects are a study objective, and participants record changes around each session and contact the principal researcher, but analysis rules are absent.

requirement: Record the reference plan's paired t tests as supplementary within-arm baseline-to-post-four-week comparisons in each group, not as the primary evidence for a randomized treatment effect.

evidence.text: The plan says paired T tests will compare before and after data in both groups.

notes: Within-arm testing does not estimate the randomized between-group contrast.

requirement: Prespecify a primary analysis that directly estimates resisted cross-education versus unresisted mirror therapy, such as baseline-adjusted follow-up analysis or a group-by-time model; do not infer efficacy from significance in one arm and nonsignificance in the other.

evidence.text: The randomized objective compares resisted mirror-aided cross-education with mirror therapy alone at repeated assessments.
The reference specifies only within-group paired tests and leaves the randomized contrast undefined.

requirement: Specify how post-four-week and three-month outcomes enter the repeated-measures analysis, including randomized group, visit, group-by-visit interaction, baseline adjustment, participant-level correlation or covariance structure and target visit contrasts.

evidence.text: The protocol schedules baseline, post-four-week and three-month assessments, but the reference plan addresses only before-after paired tests.

requirement: Define the primary randomized analysis population and as-randomized treatment attribution, with explicit rules for no training, partial adherence, crossover or unintended resistance, discontinuation and absence of every post-baseline assessment.

evidence.text: The protocol defines randomized home exercises and diaries but no analysis set or treatment-attribution rules.

requirement: Define the treatment-policy estimand or another explicit strategy for intervention discontinuation, nonadherence, additional rehabilitation, recurrent stroke or injury, and death, including population, variable, contrast, summary and time point.

evidence.text: The protocol defines a four-week home intervention and three-month follow-up but no strategy for post-randomization events.

requirement: Define item-level score rules, handling of unusable strength trials and missed four-week or three-month visits, the primary missing-data assumption and a sensitivity analysis suitable for informative dropout in a small pilot.

evidence.text: Multiple instruments and three assessment times are specified without missing-data rules.
The paired-test statement gives no missing-data assumption or sensitivity analysis.

requirement: Declare whether the pilot is estimation-focused or confirmatory and, for any confirmatory claim, specify the primary family, two-sided alpha, multiplicity control and success rule across possible co-primary strength outcomes, visits and secondary outcomes.

evidence.text: The pilot has effectiveness, feasibility and safety objectives with multiple outcomes and visits but no inferential hierarchy.

requirement: Report arm-by-visit summaries, between-arm effect estimates, two-sided confidence intervals and directions of benefit, using small-sample inference or robust uncertainty appropriate to the pilot rather than p-values alone.

evidence.text: The plan names paired t tests but no effects, confidence intervals, descriptive summaries or small-sample convention.

requirement: Document the prospective recruitment target, anticipated allocation by arm, feasibility or precision rationale and attrition allowance; do not substitute registry actual enrollment of 24 for the absent prospective target.

evidence.text: The complete three-page protocol contains no prospective sample-size target or rationale.

notes: The registry count of 24 is execution-era conduct context only.

requirement: Before any paired t test, define the paired-difference diagnostic and robust or nonparametric fallback; choose scale-appropriate analyses for ordinal Modified Ashworth data and document validated software/version rather than treating Excel and unspecified SPSS as a complete reproducibility specification.

evidence.text: The outcome set includes the ordinal Modified Ashworth Scale.
The plan names Excel, SPSS for Windows and paired t tests without versions, assumptions or fallbacks.

requirement: Prespecify baseline descriptive summaries and whether primary models adjust for gender and baseline function used in randomization, plus the baseline endpoint value; do not use baseline significance tests to decide adjustment or claim randomization success.

evidence.text: Gender and function are considered during block randomization, but analysis adjustment and baseline reporting are unspecified.
